name: eink-news
description: A signboard of the day's news, rendered for an e-ink Kindle

scripts.edition: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('src/data/news.json')){console.error('no edition yet: run \"npm run news\" first');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.feed: npm run news && npm run build && npm run render
